[[Ranger Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for rangers by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Ranger Leather Long Coat|Leather Long Coat]]
*[[Ranger Sterling Leggings|Sterling Leggings]]
*[[Ranger Embroidered Boots|Embroidered Boots]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 300{{hide}}, 20{{Leather}}, 10{{Damask}} and 30{{plat}}
